units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale estimated
description: Handheld phone looking straight down at a polished wooden gym floor. A basketball rolls (on the floor, apparently) from left to right across the upper half of the image, entering at the left edge around frame 2 and leaving at the right edge after frame 24. The filmer's shoes are visible at the bottom centre. The camera drifts slowly (about 10 px left / 57 px down over the clip).

camera.motion: handheld, slow smooth drift (no pan of note, no zoom): image content shifts by up to -9 px in x and +57 px in y by frame 30 relative to frame 0; rotation up to 0.41 deg; scale change <0.5 %
camera.per_frame_transform_file: tracks/camera.csv (2x3 similarity mapping frame-i pixel coords -> frame-0 pixel coords; bg_shift_x/y = displacement of image content at the image centre relative to frame 0)
camera.view: near-nadir top-down view of the floor; floor is effectively a plane facing the camera; mild wide-angle stretch towards image edges (ball's unblurred vertical extent ~253-256 px near the centre, ~258-268 px towards the left/right edges)

objects.name: basketball
objects.identify: the only ball; orange-brown with black seams, upper half of image (y ~ 260-580 px)
objects.visible_frames: 2-24 (frame 2: leading edge sliver only; frames 3-4 cut by left border; 5-21 fully in view; 22-24 cut by right border); not in view 0-1 and 25-30 (frame 1 shows only its shadow)
objects.reference_point: visible centre (mask centroid; edge-corrected cx_est for frames cut by the border)
objects.motion_summary: straight line left->right, nearly horizontal in image (stabilised path drops ~20 px over ~1570 px); per-frame horizontal displacement ~93-103 px (noise +/-4 px), no visible speeding up or slowing down, no bounce or direction change

objects.name: ball_shadow
objects.identify: soft grey shadow next to the ball (right of it mid-clip, left of it near the right edge); enters before the ball (frame 1)
objects.note: excluded from the ball mask; not tracked separately

objects.name: filmer_shoes
objects.identify: two light-grey/blue sneaker toes at bottom centre, either side of the blue stripe
objects.note: only toes visible, cut by bottom border; move with the camera drift only

objects.name: top_maroon_line
objects.identify: dark maroon horizontal boundary line across the top of the image
objects.orientation: tilted ~0.5 deg (rises to the right) in frame 0; spans full image width

objects.name: right_maroon_line
objects.identify: dark maroon vertical line on the right, from the top line down to the bottom edge

objects.name: left_maroon_line
objects.identify: dark maroon vertical line along the left image border (partly cut off)
objects.note: cut by the left border; true width unknown

objects.name: blue_stripe
objects.identify: light-blue (pale) vertical stripe in the middle, between the shoes, from the top maroon line to the bottom edge

objects.name: light_reflections
objects.identify: two bright ceiling-light reflections on the floor, frame-0 approx. centres (550, 710) and (1290, 720); plus bluish window reflections along the left edge (x ~ 35-110)

objects.name: floor_boards
objects.identify: vertical hardwood floor strips, ~60-100 px wide in the image

events.event: ball shadow appears at left edge
ball first visible (leading edge at left border)
ball centre crosses blue stripe centre
ball centre crosses right maroon line centre
ball starts leaving at right border
no bounce, impact, release or direction change observed

files.tracks/basketball.csv: per-frame ball track (all 31 frames; visible flag)
files.tracks/camera.csv: per-frame camera similarity transform to frame 0
files.track_check.jpg: stabilised track and bboxes drawn on frame 0
